resources.string: A panel at the screen edge: apps and an LG TV remote, one pull away
Pull the handle inwards or tap it
Pull the bar at the screen edge inwards and the panel comes out with your finger. A tap opens it too. Drag the bar up or down to move it.
Once started, a thin bar stays at the screen edge, on top of every app.
Turn on “Display over other apps” so the bar and panel can show on top of other apps, then come back.
Drag the bar up or down with your finger; its place is saved.
Handle moved back to its default place
Tick the apps for the panel. The order you tick them is their order in the panel.
You can choose up to %1$d apps
This phone has an infrared emitter
This phone has no infrared emitter
This phone has no infrared emitter; the TV remote cannot work.
Point the top edge of the phone at the TV. The power key sends the LG remote\'s power code; the HDMI keys use LG\'s direct input codes. You can try them here with the buttons below.
Needed for the bar and the panel
A small notification stays while the panel is on
So it keeps running in the background
Turn on “Display pop-up windows while running in the background” and autostart so the panel can open apps
The panel follows your finger while you pull and springs open when you let go. Its contents come in one after another, keys squeeze and ripple, and the background blurs.
This screen goes up to %1$d Hz. %2$d Hz is requested while pulling and while the panel is open, then back to normal.
This screen goes up to %1$d Hz; animations run at that rate (90 FPS needs a 90 Hz screen).
